description: **Cancels a paid inbound transfer and refunds the order.** Confirm with the user first. The order is deliberate: mark cancelled locally, withdraw at the registry, verify the registry accepted the withdrawal, then refund. If the registry state cannot be confirmed it restores the transfer and returns TRANSFER_STATE_UNCONFIRMED rather than refunding something that may still be live — escalate to support in that case rather than retrying. The response reports withdrawnAtRegistry, registryResultCode, refunded and refundAmount.
